platform_final.failure_reason: Runner exited with test failures or runtime errors

confirmed_facts.fact: The final platform execution reached all 34 Playwright tests and passed 33; the only final failure was REQ-2.2.
REQ-2.2 timed out after 10016ms while waiting for the BookStack User text through the reported heading locator.
The final report says the element was not found; it does not provide final DOM, screenshot, response body, cookie header or trace evidence.
The internal acceptance histories are different from the final platform result: round 0 failed REQ-2.2, round 1 failed REQ-4.3.1, and round 2 failed REQ-2.2 plus REQ-8.2.
The final platform run.json/tests list only REQ-2.2 as failed; this is authoritative over internal repair-round node lists.

The generated package contains a complete frontend/backend application tree and a database user whose nickname is BookStack User; static backend code has a login handler, session cookie path and authenticated navigation injection.
confirmed_facts.source: template ZIP inventory, backend/src/server.js and backend/data/db.json

confirmed_facts.fact: The run used main.py, /workspace/tests and one final Playwright worker; bundled fallback hits were zero and raw logs had no sk- plaintext.
Provider usage recorded 1215 requests and 31,206,622 provider-total tokens; platform metering recorded 42,725,779 tokens and 22.194327 CNY.

chain: Final Playwright suite started with 34 tests and one worker
REQ-2.2 login flow reached the post-login visibility assertion
The reported BookStack User locator did not resolve to a visible element within 10 seconds
33/34 passed and the platform finalized FAILED with score 97.1

root_cause_candidates.candidate: The authenticated homepage did not expose the expected nickname in a DOM form recognized as visible by the final test at assertion time.
evidence: The final failure is specifically a missing visible BookStack User locator
The same final suite passed the other 33 flows, including authenticated operations
Static package renders the nickname as a span.nav-user rather than a heading; the final helper revision used at runtime is not fully captured
root_cause_candidates.boundary: This identifies the likely failing boundary, not whether the text was absent, hidden, semantically mismatched, or rendered after the assertion.

root_cause_candidates.candidate: A semantic/selector compatibility mismatch exists between the generated authenticated navigation and the public helper's effective locator fallback.
evidence: The package's static authenticated marker is span.nav-user
The runtime error does not show the actual helper source revision or final DOM
root_cause_candidates.boundary: The repository snapshot helper contains fallback locators, so this cannot be called confirmed without the exact runtime helper and DOM.

evidence: REQ-2.2 is reached after the login helper

No final /api/login response, Set-Cookie header or GET / response was captured

minimal_read_only_reproduction.action: Start the exact template package locally and execute only the REQ-2.2 flow with response, cookie, final URL, DOM text and accessibility snapshot capture.
minimal_read_only_reproduction.expected_observation: Determine whether /api/login succeeds, whether the session cookie is retained, and whether BookStack User is present as text, heading, or hidden content.

minimal_read_only_reproduction.action: Compare the runtime helper's effective locator fallback with the generated authenticated navigation element and test getByRole('heading') versus getByText('BookStack User') without changing the official helper.
minimal_read_only_reproduction.expected_observation: If getByText succeeds while the heading locator fails, the defect is semantic/selector compatibility; if both fail, inspect session or rendering response.

minimal_read_only_reproduction.action: Perform a static read-only contract check that the authenticated server response contains the fixture nickname after a valid cookie and that the built dist file preserves the injection marker.
minimal_read_only_reproduction.expected_observation: Separate source/build mismatch from runtime session or DOM-visibility behavior.

stage5_recommendation.acceptance: Stage5 should receive this as a narrow REQ-2.2 post-login identity readback diagnosis. Do not treat it as proof that the login API or server authentication is broken.
priority: P0: reproduce REQ-2.2 with final DOM, accessibility, response and cookie capture before changing code.
P0: verify the exact runtime helper revision and its effective locator fallback against the generated nav element.
P1: if confirmed, make the smallest compatibility change to authenticated nickname rendering/semantics or stable visible readback; preserve the existing session path.
P1: add a local targeted gate for login response, session cookie, final homepage nickname and the authenticated dashboard headings.
P1: only after targeted convergence, spend on a full platform rerun; avoid broad repair loops that destabilize already passing requirements.
Do not modify official tests or use internal repair-round failures as the final failure list.
change_boundary: frontend/src/styles.css only if visibility evidence confirms a CSS issue
local targeted validation and build/readback checks
do_not_do: No authentication rewrite before capturing response and cookie evidence
No global Playwright timeout increase as the first fix
No changes based solely on internal round 1 or round 2 failure nodes
Do not merge this Run's diagnosis with other BookStack Run conclusions

impact_estimate.completion_rate: Fixing the single final failure would move 33/34 (97.1%) to 34/34 (100%), an absolute gain of 2.9 percentage points.
impact_estimate.token: The Run used 1215 requests and 31,206,622 provider-total tokens; platform metering reports 42,725,779 tokens. A narrow local fix should avoid repeating broad repair loops, but exact savings are not measurable from this Run.
impact_estimate.cost: Platform metering cost was 22.194327 CNY; avoid full reruns until targeted evidence converges.
impact_estimate.time: Total run duration was 8548s (~2.37h); final Playwright execution took about 31.6s and the failed assertion consumed 10016ms. The likely fix is small, but full-run generation time dominates.
impact_estimate.risk: Changing shared authentication/session logic risks regressing the 33 passing tests; prefer a narrow nickname readback/semantic change after reproduction.
